description: This file defines a custom ArrayAdapter named CustomArrayAdapter used to populate and manage list items in an expandable list view, specifically for items of type ExpandableListItem. It includes methods for inflating list item views, setting data on views, managing layout parameters for expanded/collapsed states, and processing images to crop them into circular bitmaps.

classes.name: CustomArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for expandable list items that manages view inflation, data binding, and image processing.

methods.name: CustomArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, layout resource ID, and data list.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the view for a list item, binds data, and adjusts layout based on expansion state.

methods.name: getCroppedBitmap
methods.description: Creates a circular cropped version of the provided bitmap.
